entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I think I need to make a return? I'm not really sure how it works. I'm a bit overwhelmed.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Gable. The order number is... VF88-621-B. It's for that helmet I ordered a while back.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order right here for the AeroFlow helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more a matter of preference?

Oh, I'm just so confused. I thought the color would be different, you know? It doesn't really match my bike the way I thought it would. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just want to make sure everything is right for my safety. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help. It's completely understandable to want the color to be perfect, and safety is our top priority at VeloFit. Let me just pull up the details on your order.
Okay, I see the delivery was made 49 days ago. Per our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund. We can definitely get this processed for you.
Oh, thank goodness! I was so worried I had waited too long. That's such a relief.

Not at all, you're perfectly fine. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. And because I see you're a VIP member with us, I've gone ahead and added a 15% discount code to that email for your next purchase, to help you find the perfect helmet.
Wow, really? That's so nice of you! Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so easy.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
